explanation: Brothers Malcolm and Angus Young were born in Glasgow, but their family emigrated to Sydney in 1963. The brothers formed AC/DC there ten years later.

claims.text: AC/DC was formed in Sydney, Australia, in 1973.
AC/DC was not formed in Scotland, England or the United States.
Malcolm and Angus Young were born in Glasgow, Scotland, and emigrated with their family to Sydney in 1963.
Malcolm and Angus Young founded AC/DC.
